semantics.active: operand of >=1 gate in the span
semantics.idle: untouched; not known empty (may hold data)
semantics.zero: |0>: op-semantics-forced (alloc, and HMR/R demolition; only X/CX/CCX/Swap targets write values); never sampled or inferred
semantics.io: declared-register wires hold evaluator-loaded data from birth; their allocation never marks them zero
semantics.coords: interval state_segments are [phase_start, phase_end, state] in fine phase indices
